notes.title: Launch Day
notes.content:
The official Steam release of Sea of Blood is here! Tell your friends, show your family, but more importantly, play it for yourself. And have fun! Thank you, once again, to anyone who has taken an interest in the game. Thank you to all my friends and family who supported me during the two-year long development journey. I am very excited I was able to put myself in a situation where I could develop a game like this. I hope anyone who buys it will enjoy playing it, just as I enjoyed developing it.

[b]Got A Question?[/b]
For any inquires or feedback, shoot an e-mail to: support@shimagara.games

notes.title: Launch Week
notes.content:
The official Steam release of Sea of Blood is getting near. With only a couple days left, I would like to take the time to thank anyone who has taken an interest in the game. It has been almost two long years of solo-developing, and I am very excited to have come this far. it has been a great learning experience and I hope you will all enjoy it. But I am sure that is not what you came here for, so I won't bore you with fancy words. On to the details!

[b]The Release[/b]
Sea of Blood will officially launch on the 25th of February 2021 at 12:00am PST.

[b]The Price[/b]
The full price at launch will be $8.99 (USD), or equivalent in your selected region.

[b]Got A Question?[/b]
For any other inquires or feedback, shoot an e-mail to: support@shimagara.games

Please look forward to it!
